newsitem.title: MOZAMBIQUE: Mozambique exporters can retain foreign exchange.
newsitem.headline: Mozambique exporters can retain foreign exchange.

text.p: Mozambique exporters will be able to retain 100 percent of their foreign exchange earnings in foreign currency, Prime Minister Pascoal Mocumbi told parliament in his budget speech on Monday.
The change of policy ends a requirement for them to convert 35 percent of export earnings into meticais.
Exchange rates would continue to be determined by the market, but Mocumbi said he was optimistic the metical would remain stable.
Between January and November the metical had fallen in value by only five percent, he said. ($=11,125)
